s: Don't buy in just any store, benefit ... or go to the Portologia store in Porto. Yes, it seems incongruous to come home with a can of sardines and yet, it is a product that is an integral part of Portuguese culture. Classic, with a retro or designer look, canned goods are also pretty, colorful decorative objects, a great way to please at a low price. Go to the unmissable Loja das Conservas (the canned goods shop), the Mercearia das Flores delicatessen or the A Vida Portuguesa boutique...
